correctness.rationale: In rank two choose independent unit-modulus rows u,v and write z_j=v_j/u_j. At most two ratio values imply at most two projective column classes, since each column is scaled from the evaluation of every row's two coefficients at that ratio. If at least three distinct values occur, every linear combination αu+βv that is an actual row must satisfy a constant real affine functional on at least three points of the unit circle; a nonconstant one has at most two. Hence αβ=0, giving at most two row classes. Rank one, including one-row or one-column shapes, has one class. Conversely at most two proportional classes in either direction bound the rank by two. For Fourier rows, proportionality means χ(r−s) is independent of χ∈C, exactly the H_C relation; the column condition is its K_R dual. This establishes the capped rank identity, not an exact rank above two. For 3p and four distinct indices no four-set lies in one mod-p fiber (capacity 3). Its differences generate the p-coordinate, and also the 3-coordinate unless the set is pure mod 3. Therefore H_C is trivial or the order-three subgroup, and likewise dually. Rank two means exactly one mod-3-pure side, opposite a set on two mod-p fibers; rank one is impossible. The two roles are disjoint because a mod-3-pure four-set has four distinct mod-p residues. The counts 3 binom(p,4) and (3+9+3) binom(p,2), multiplied by two, give the exact incidence law. The independent replay used exact cyclotomic determinants, not finite-field ranks, for all 3,969 nonempty rectangles at order six and affine-orbit weighted four-set pairs at orders 15 and 21, obtaining 4,500 and 66,150 rank-two pairs and no rank-one pairs at the latter two orders.
residual_risks: For the frozen two-prime certificate the norm bound establishes that the maximum of the specialized ranks is the complex rank, not that each prime alone must preserve it. The code checks equality of the two ranks for its 1,089 representative pairs before reporting the data. Under independent row/column affine changes, the scalings produce both nonzero phases and a cyclotomic Galois automorphism; these preserve whether each complex minor vanishes. Finite tests corroborate only the stated moduli; the proof supplies the universal quantifiers.

evidence: For independent rows u,v with three distinct ratios, choose those three columns and add any third row w. No columns of this 3×3 are proportional, already on u,v; these two rows are independent on the three columns. If the older lemma forces two proportional rows, w must be proportional there to u or v. The uniqueness of its two coefficients on any two different ratios extends this proportionality to every column. If there are fewer ratios the two-column-class conclusion is immediate. This formally shows how a verified older proportional-pair lemma would cover the arbitrary rectangle, with the Fourier criterion following by substituting the annihilator class counts.

An exact earlier 3×3 proportionality criterion just on Z_(3p) would suffice for the same argument on its rectangles and would make the larger-size occupancy count a short consequence. The earlier catalog descriptions give rank census and coincidence dependence without the exact general predicate needed for that implication; the frozen proof and later cited assessments acknowledge a small lemma, but do not quote its older hypotheses and conclusion.

value.rationale: The rank-two cutoff is a natural identifiability threshold for restrictions of a character table. The coset criterion replaces determinant searches by a direct structural test, and the 3p result gives the complete rank-two occurrence set and precise four-channel incidence over an infinite family, not merely a known small-modulus table or a singularity total that conflates defects. Value is assigned to this exact criterion and incidence, not to the elementary unit-circle observation by itself.
